name: Goonown Lane
note: Access for vehicles is unclear, see: https://www.openstreetmap.org/changeset/124085730

Shown in local authority PRoW data as a BOAT but has been mapped as a footpath. From non-OSM-compatible sources, it looks like it wouldn't be possible to drive a vehicle down it due to width restrictions and the removal of the dropped kerb.
